Carma (YC W24) | Founding Full-Stack Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | $175K–$225K + 0.5%–1.0% equity

Carma (https://www.joincarma.com/) is an AI-native operating system for enterprise fleet operations. Construction and electrical contracting fleets run thousands of vehicles and heavy-duty equipment on our platform in production today. When a truck breaks down, gets recalled, or sits idle, our AI operator, Neo, detects it, orchestrates the repair, and drives it to resolution. Ship a feature in the morning; a fleet manager in the field is using it within the hour.

Why it's technically interesting: real-world software with messy, adversarial data — telematics streams, OEM recall feeds, vendor invoices, DOT compliance — fused into workflows that AI executes. The incumbents in this multi-billion-dollar market ship on decade-old stacks. Backed by Soma Capital, Y Combinator, founders of Superhuman, and Tier-1 investors, we are sprinting toward a Series A in 2026.

Stack: TypeScript end-to-end — React, NestJS, PostgreSQL + Prisma, AWS.

Founding Full-Stack Engineer: $175K–$225K + 0.5%–1.0% equity. Own product surfaces end-to-end: ambiguous problem statement → scoped design → shipped to enterprise users.

Onsite in SF six days a week, early-stage pace, high ownership and high expectations. Our process is fast, strong candidates go from first conversation to offer in days.

Email suleyman@joincarma.com with 2–3 lines on the hardest system you've shipped end-to-end. We reply to every thoughtful email within 24 hours.
